speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent. I see you're experiencing generalized fatigue and severe itching alongside abnormal liver tests. Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That history of ulcerative colitis and your sexual history raises concern for primary sclerosing cholangitis or a sexually transmitted infection like syphilis; have you noticed any right upper quadrant abdominal pain or jaundice recently? Also, could you confirm if you have experienced any recent weight loss or fever?

REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (bilirubin fractions, ALP, GGT, ALT, AST), Hepatitis A-F serology, RPR for syphilis, and ANCA.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver function panel: Bilirubin_Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct 0.9 mg/dL, Alkaline_Phosphatase 460 U/L, AST 75 U/L, ALT 78 U/L; Hepatitis A-F serology: Negative; RPR: Negative; ANCA: Negative; Imaging: Abdominal Ultrasound shows thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.
